subject: Provisional capacity hold request for SentinelLoop Q1 trial (DEAL-7821)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-10-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Provisional capacity hold request for SentinelLoop Q1 trial (DEAL-7821)

Team —

SentinelLoop is moving to a commercial trial and needs a short-term dedicated footprint for a 6-week pilot starting early Jan (they want a provisional start window Jan 6–Feb 16). Rough ask from commercial: 8 x A100 (40GB) sustained, with burst to 12 for heavy eval windows. The HS contact is Karin (cc'd in later messages).

Can infra confirm whether we can place a provisional hold on the requested capacity in us-west-2 for an 8-week window, with an ops SLA that allows quick ramp to 12 units if we see spike? If we can't commit to physical A100s, propose compatible alternatives (e.g. 8 x L40S + 4 x spare preemptible GPUs) and provide estimated delta on latency/cost.

Attached is our sizing table from the deal desk (sentinelloop_sizing_table_v3.xlsx). Please include retention/eviction risk and a short ops runbook bullet list so sales can share with the customer.

Need a capacity snapshot and a recommended provisional hold (duration, min units, any prepay terms) by EOD Monday so we can share with procurement.

Thanks —
Jordan
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-10-21T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional capacity hold request for SentinelLoop Q1 trial (DEAL-7821)

Jordan / team —

Quick availability snapshot for us-west-2 (current committed pool and tentative standbys attached): capacity_snapshot_us-west-2.csv (summary below).
- Free permanent A100 (40GB) slots: 6
- Available L40S equivalent nodes: 14
- Preemptible spare pool: 18 nodes (various SKUs)
- Concurrent reserved commitments in Jan window: 4 (other enterprise POCs)

Given current bookings, we cannot guarantee 8 permanent A100s without displacing an existing standby request. Two options:
1) Provisional soft-hold: Reserve 6 guaranteed A100s + 6 L40S to match compute; this gives capacity parity with a minor perf delta. Hold duration: 8 weeks. No hard eviction unless cross-region emergency.
2) Hard reservation (preferred by sales for predictability): Require a 40% prepayment to lock 8 A100-equivalent units for the Jan window — we would shift other near-term standbys. Lead time to lock: 72 hours after sign-off; billing/finance needs a PO + payment term.

Ops runbook highlights (short):
- Prefix caching policy: enable KV cache snapshot for pilot to reduce token cost.
- Auto-burst policy: scale to 12 units with 5-minute warmup; sustained burst allowed for up to 12 hours/day.
- Fallback: if physical A100 shortage hits, route to L40S with quantization knob (expected +10–18% latency).

I attached the raw CSV for capacity planning and can run a more detailed perf delta test if you want latency estimates on their sample prompt set.

Ben
Principal, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karin Lund <karin@sentinelloop.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-10-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Provisional capacity hold request for SentinelLoop Q1 trial (DEAL-7821)

Karin —

Forwarding our internal availability notes. High level: we can provision an equivalent footprint for your Jan pilot but there are two choices: a soft provisional hold (no prepay, small eviction risk) or a hard reservation (requires a 40% prepay to guarantee hardware). Ben's snapshot is attached.

If you want to lock predictability for the pilot, we typically ask partners to sign a short MOU and a 40% deposit to secure the reservation. I attached a draft for your legal ops (MOU_SentinelLoop_v1.pdf). If SentinelLoop prefers the soft route, we'll mark a soft-hold and prioritize warmup but won't be able to provide an SLA-backed hard commit.

Can you confirm which path you'd like? If you want hard reserve, confirm we should route DocuSign to karin@sentinelloop.ai and cc your procurement contact.

Cheers —
Jordan

From: Karin Lund <karin@sentinelloop.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@sentinelloop.ai
Date: 2029-10-22T14:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Provisional capacity hold request for SentinelLoop Q1 trial (DEAL-7821)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options. Procurement prefers predictability for the trial; we'll take the hard reservation. Please send the MOU via DocuSign to karin@sentinelloop.ai and I will loop in our CFO (cc: ops) for the deposit. We expect legal sign-off within 48 business hours once we get the DocuSign.

Can you also include the expected latency delta between A100 and the L40S fallback? Our engineering team wants to know the risk for peak batches.

—Karin
Head of Infrastructure
SentinelLoop

Jordan / team —

Great — customer asked for hard reservation. Next steps I propose:
1) Sales: finalize MOU and route via DocuSign. Jordan, please send signed MOU link to finance.
